تحترمون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَرِمُونَ (taḥtarimūna) /taħ.ta.ri.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# تُحْتَرَمُونَ (tuḥtaramūna) /tuħ.ta.ra.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
